queries.name: the stale-processing population, partitioned by target
queries.method: read-only SELECT target, count(*), min(updated_at), max(updated_at) FROM distribution_outbox WHERE status = 'processing' AND updated_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY target
queries.result: 4 targets, 8 rows each, 32 total. All four are synthetic canary targets; every row was written 2026-07-30. Zero rows on any governed delivery target.
queries.significance: This is the exact population worker_outbox_health was failing on. Under isGovernedDeliveryTarget() all 32 partition to bucket 5b (unclaimable) and none to 5a (claimable), so the repaired gate passes on today's production shape while still failing on a single genuine stuck row.

queries.name: the claimable bucket is empty in production
queries.method: same query, filtered to rows whose target is a member of governedDeliveryTargets
queries.significance: The assertion the repaired T1 control makes — claimable.length === 0 — holds against production right now. The control is therefore green for the right reason rather than vacuous.
